headline: Nigeria's NNPC Posts September Profit of $378M on $3.4B Revenue
summary: Nigeria's state-owned oil company, NNPC, posted a September profit of approximately US$378 million on US$3.4 billion in revenue, with output reaching 3.04 million barrels per day.
why: NNPC plays a central role in Nigeria's economy and national budget through its oil production and revenue generation.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: State oil earnings directly affect national fiscal revenues.
